panels.title: Distinct table_ids (logical)

targets.rawSql: select count(distinct table_id)::bigint as logical_tables from mud.records

panels.description: Count of unique logical tables encoded within mud.records (not DB base tables).

targets.rawSql: select block_number::bigint as chain_head from meta.chain_head where chain_id = 695569 order by ts desc limit 1
select relname as table, reltuples::bigint as approx_rows from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='mud' and relkind='r' order by reltuples desc limit 20

with ch as (select block_number::bigint as head from meta.chain_head where chain_id=695569 order by ts desc limit 1), pr as (select max(block_number)::bigint as proc from meta.processed_head where chain_id=695569) select (ch.head - pr.proc) as lag from ch, pr
select max(block_number)::bigint as latest_block from mud.records
select $__timeGroup(ts, ''1m'') as time, max(block_number)::bigint as value from meta.chain_head where chain_id=695569 and $__timeFilter(ts) group by 1 order by 1
select $__timeGroup(ts, ''1m'') as time, max(block_number)::bigint as value from meta.processed_head where chain_id=695569 and $__timeFilter(ts) group by 1 order by 1

with s as (select $__timeGroup(ts, ''1m'') as bucket, max(block_number)::bigint as head from meta.chain_head where chain_id=695569 and $__timeFilter(ts) group by 1 order by 1) select bucket as time, (head - lag(head) over (order by bucket)) as value from s

with s as (select $__timeGroup(ts, ''1m'') as bucket, max(block_number)::bigint as head from meta.processed_head where chain_id=695569 and $__timeFilter(ts) group by 1 order by 1) select bucket as time, (head - lag(head) over (order by bucket)) as value from s

panels.title: Top table_ids by rows (mud.records)

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(n.label, encode(m.table_id,'hex')) as table_label, count(*) as rows, max(m.block_number)::bigint as latest_block from mud.records m left join meta.table_names n on n.table_id = m.table_id group by 1 order by rows desc limit 50

panels.description: This schema stores decoded data in a generic records table keyed by table_id; friendly names require a registry table or mapping.

select block_number::bigint as block, count(*) as rows from mud.records group by block_number order by block_number desc limit 50
select (block_number::bigint/1000)*1000 as block_bucket, count(*) as rows from mud.records group by 1 order by 1 desc limit 20
